ref_name._comment: MERGE TARGETS ONLY — branches you merge INTO, never a glob over branches you work ON. These rules gate PUSHES to any matching ref, so `refs/heads/feat/**` would make every feature branch reject your own commits with GH013. GitHub rulesets cannot express 'gate this ref when it is a PR base but allow pushes when it is a PR head', so a stacked PR's base must be named explicitly while the stack is open. Do NOT hardcode one here: this file is shipped verbatim to other repositories by bootstrap-review-gates.sh, and a branch name from THIS repo would protect a name that is meaningless there while leaving that repo's real stack bases open. Pass them per-target instead: MERGE_TARGETS=refs/heads/feat/foo bootstrap-review-gates.sh owner/repo. Keys prefixed with _ are stripped before the payload is submitted, because the API rejects unrecognised parameters with a 422.
